name: praxis-core
description: Shared Praxis libraries — contracts, CLI, VCS, Jira, plugin-sdk, knowledge

scripts.build: npm run build -w @praxis/contracts -w @praxis/knowledge -w @praxis/project-config -w @praxis/catalog -w @praxis/testing --if-present && npm run build -w @praxis/plugin-sdk --if-present && npm run build -w @praxis/jira -w @praxis/vcs --if-present && npm run build -w @praxis/cli --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:tests && npm run accept:git-delivery-lib
